STORED DATA, REFERENCE DATA AND OUTCOMES
plans: planting registry (buyers see totals only)
polls: priced needs, commitments, reference codes
chats, farm profile, irrigation log, energy log
crop table: yield, cost, MSP, procurement, loss
FAO-56 Kc, root depth, depletion; FAO-33 Ky
emission factors: grid 0.727 kg/kWh, diesel 2.68 kg/L
Water: m3 per acre over 30 simulated seasons
Energy: pump kWh and kg CO2 per season
Waste: harvest matched to a priced buyer
Income: usual-year and bad-year profit per acre
Today: JSON files and a Streamlit app (prototype). Production: one database table per file, same modules. Demo vendors and prices are synthetic.
